name: Broderick Boat Ramp
parking_info: Free in boat ramp area - in hogher flows you may have to park outside of the area and walk in
walk_to_water: ~600 ft, across paved parking lot and down ramp to waterline
cautions: Swift water at the ramp; no lifeguard
note: Popular fishing boat put-in, unhoused folks are nice and abundant

name: Tiscornia Beach
parking_info: Sac Regional Parks controlled, if you have a pass you can park for free.
note: Sandy beach at the confluence; life jackets on site.

name: Discovery Park Boat Ramp
parking_info: Sac Regional Parks controlled, if you have a pass you can park for free.
walk_to_water: ~600 ft, across paved parking lot and down ramp to waterline
note: To get to this take the paddler must turn upriver at confluence and go upstream a bit to enter the cover where the boat ramp is located. Also, shuttle drivers must drive across the bridge to the boat ramp - farther than Tiscornia.

name: Sutter's Landing
parking_info: Park at the end of the road to the skate park - City of Sacramento managed lot. If full, park near bocce courts or dog park after (boat drop off).
walk_to_water: ~750 ft. across bike path and down steep levee to trails to waterline.

name: Paradise Beach

note: Glen Hall Park / River Park; popular beach.
